What happens to my USDC when I create a: What happens to my USDC when I create a pledge?
Your USDC is transferred to a secure vau: Your USDC is safely stored in a vault on Solana. Complete your goal 100% and you get every penny back — no fees!
What if I only partially complete my goa: What if I only partially complete my goal?
You get back a proportional amount minus: You'll get back a proportional amount minus a small 1% fee. For example, pledge $10 and complete 50% — you get $4.95 back.
What happens if I forget to report?: What happens if I forget to report?
We give you a 24-hour grace period to re: We give you a 24-hour grace period to report your daily tasks — so if you forget today, you can still do it tomorrow. Once your pledge deadline is reached, you also get a 24-hour grace period to report your final results and claim your tokens.
What are daily tasks vs one-time tasks?: What are daily tasks vs one-time tasks?
Daily tasks repeat on your chosen schedu: Daily tasks repeat on your chosen schedule — every day, weekdays, weekends, or custom days. One-time tasks are goals you complete once during your pledge. Mix both types to build the perfect plan!
Can I edit a pledge after creating it?: Can I edit a pledge after creating it?
Yes, you can edit your pledge name, task: Yes! You can edit your pledge name, rename tasks, and add new goals at any time before the deadline — completely free, no penalty. You can't remove existing tasks (it would affect your completion tracking), and the pledge amount and deadline are locked on-chain once created.
If it is self-reporting, can't I just ch: If it is self-reporting, can't I just cheat and always get all my tokens back?
Yes, the purpose of Pledge is not to for: Yes, the purpose of Pledge is not to force you to be honest with yourself. It is to be a reliable companion that reminds you and holds you accountable for reporting your own goals.
Forfeited funds are split between the Pl: Forfeited funds are split between the Pledge treasury and a charity wallet. 30% goes to a non-profit organization — so even if you fall short, your pledge still does some good!
Pledge is open-source software — all cod: Pledge is fully open-source — anyone can review the code! However, the smart contracts haven't been formally audited yet. We recommend starting with small amounts. Never pledge more than you're comfortable with!

First of all, that was not a question. S: First of all, that was not a question. Second of all, no one is forcing you to use it. So feel free to not use Pledge and go do 1,000 push-ups, David Goggins.

You can reach us through our Telegram co: You can reach us through our Telegram community or follow us on X (Twitter).

How long do I have to claim my tokens af: How long do I have to claim my tokens after the pledge deadline?
You can settle anytime, though early set: You can settle anytime, though early settling may cost you points and tokens if you have unfinished tasks. If your pledge is 100% complete, you have up to 6 months to claim your tokens. If it's less than 100%, Pledge will automatically settle for you 24 hours after the deadline.
onboarding_welcome_body: Set a goal, pledge your USDC, and earn it back by following through. Pledge keeps you accountable.
onboarding_how_body:
1. Create a goal with tasks and a deadline
2. Pledge your USDC as commitment
3. Check off your tasks daily to build your completion percentage
4. Report your results and get your tokens back
onboarding_checkoff_body:
Your completion percentage is based on the tasks you check off. Each unchecked task lowers your percentage — and that means fewer tokens returned.

Check off your tasks every day to protect your pledge. If you forget, you have a 24-hour grace period to go back and check them off.
onboarding_tasks_body: Daily tasks repeat on your chosen schedule — every day, weekdays, weekends, or custom days. One-time tasks are marked with a "Not daily" button and are goals you complete once during your pledge period. Mix both types in a single pledge.
onboarding_rules_body:
Complete 100% → get your full pledge back, zero fees.
Partial completion → proportional refund minus a small 1% fee.
0% completion → pledge is forfeited.

30% of all forfeited funds go to a non-profit organization. So your loss still helps someone in need.

Details of the non-profit organization we work with can be found in the FAQ page in Settings.
onboarding_grace_body: After your deadline, you have 24 hours to self-report your completion for the most accurate result. If you don't report in time, we'll calculate it automatically based on the tasks you checked off.
onboarding_ready_body: Create your first pledge and start achieving your goals. You can revisit this guide anytime in Settings.
